scope: Offline verification of the local evidence archive; no optimization or network requests.

credential_scan.method: Private key, common GitHub/OpenAI/AWS token and credential-in-URL patterns over text artifacts
credential_scan.limit: Pattern scan, not a guarantee that every form of sensitive data is absent.

limits: Historical paths and record IDs retained in byte-preserved evidence
_release_note: Historical original-evidence record. Hashes and publication state refer to the private prepublication snapshot, not the sanitized release. See release-manifest.json and verification-public.json.
